ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Combating of Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing Law of 12 November 2004 (Loi du 12 novembre 2004 relative à la lutte contre le blanchiment et contre le financement du terrorisme), as consolidated and amended; Luxembourg Act of 13 January 2019 establishing the Register of Beneficial Owners (Registre des Bénéficiaires Effectifs, RBE), implementing Directive (EU) 2015/849 (4AMLD) and Directive (EU) 2018/843 (5AMLD); Grand-Ducal Regulations of 10 February 2020 and 22 July 2020 on operational details of the RBE; Law of 25 March 2020 establishing an administrative transparency register; CSSF Regulation 16-07 (amended) on the fight against money laundering and terrorist financing applicable to professionals; Law of 27 June 2018 (einheitsregelung) as updated by the Law of 7 July 2022 on digital operational resilience and AML harmonization; and EU Regulation (EU) 2024/1624 as supplemented by national implementing provisions on single access points to beneficial ownership information.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing / Excerpt from the Commercial Register (Registre de Commerce et des Sociétés – RCS) for the legal entity shareholder (if applicable)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Luxembourg Business Register (LBR) / Ministere du Commerce / competent trade registry authority in the entity's country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille Convention (Convention of 5 October 1961) for non-EU origin documents; for EU-origin documents, inspection of authenticity through EU cross-border electronic interconnection (BRIS) may suffice, but apostille remains the safest form

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of the founder's / UBO's civil passport or national identity card
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: National civil registry or consular post of the country of issuance
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (if required for sub-document authentication); otherwise certified by a notary in the country of issuance and apostilled if the origin state is a Hague contracting state; consular legalization for origin states outside the Hague Convention

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter or evidence of source of funds (source-of-wealth declaration) for each UBO
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Credit institution licensed in the issuing jurisdiction, authenticated by the AML compliance officer
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Apostille or consular legalization applicable to the underlying certificate of capacity of the signing officer; alternatively, verified through correspondent banking channels with the Luxembourg registrar

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Police clearance certificate (certificat de bonnes vie et mœurs / extract from criminal record) for each natural-person UBO and manager (gérant)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Criminal records office (Casier judiciaire) or Ministry of Justice of the UBO's country of ordinary residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille for applicant states under the 1961 Convention; consular legalization portal (e-legalization or Ministry of Foreign Affairs) for non-contracting states

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified translation (French, German, or English for operational filing; French/German mandatory for notarial deeds filed with the RCS) of all corporate constitutive documents and the notarized incorporation deed
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Sworn translator accredited by the Luxembourg Ministry of Justice or a Luxembourg notary public (notaire)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Translation affidavit affixed to the authenticated original; apostille of the original document being translated, when applicable

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of each director, gérant, UBO, and authorized signatory against the consolidated UN Security Council sanctions lists, OFAC SDN and non-SDN lists (if US dollar business is contemplated), EU consolidated financial sanctions list (EU Council Regulation EC No 765/2006 and EU Regulation (EU) 269/2014 as amended), UK HMT sanctions list if material to banking relationships, and the Luxembourg Ministry of Finance's national freezing list; PEP status must be verified for at least 36 months post-exit using both conservative (international position-based) and legal-competence (function-based, consistent with FATF guidance) analysis; enhanced due diligence (EDD) via Luxembourg notarial and RBE filing channel is required where any PEP is identified or where the project presents higher residual AML risk; reliance on external screening must be documented under a risk-based approach compliant with CSSF Regulation 16-07 Chapter 3 and section 3 of the Law of 12 November 2004.
ubo_and_aml_profiling.ubo_integration_and_tax_registrars: RBE filing with the Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR) is required in parallel with the notarial deed (Loi du 13 janvier 2019, articles 3 and 7); distinction between 'beneficial owner' (person ultimately owning 25% + 1 voting unit) and 'possession as trustee' (administrateur de biens) must be declared to the notary; the RBE remains partially non-public (public access limited to 'have a legitimate connection', under Articles L. 231-14 – L. 231-16 of the amended law of 13 January 2019, as modified by Etude d'Impact of the Court of Justice of the European Union case law, C-37/20 Luxembourg Business Registers).

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Luxembourg Business Registers interactive RCS application and availability checker (https://www.lbr.lu / https://www.rcslu.lu and the official 'ndd.lu' business register online portal; primary RCS extract is via le registre de commerce et des sociétés, Luxembourg Business Registers e-services DOI, https://www.lbr.lu/mjrcs/)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The name must be written in Latin characters and may optionally include accented characters used in the French/German language environments; for SARLs, the name may be freely chosen but must not mislead the public nor create confusion with existing trade names; where the corporate activity is marketed bilingually, an official translation or transliteration into French is maintained and registered as a secondary formula; names in scripts other than Latin (e.g., Chinese or Cyrillic) are not accepted as the sole corporate name — a Latin-character transliteration must be designated as the legal corporate identifier; only official IPA-like transliteration (based on Luxembourg Ministry of Justice guidance) is permitted for registration of foreign characters; the notarial deed must record the transliteration as the official name and any foreign-script name only as an informal alias.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Société d'investissement (SIF), Fonds d'investissement, UCITS, OPC
État / État du Luxembourg / Grand-Duché (state-affiliated wording)
Chambre de Commerce (unless represented by the Chamber of Commerce itself)
CE, European Union, EU (any phrase implying EU institution affiliation)

Holding (without restrictions – acceptable in the appropriate context, but if used as the first token it may trigger intermediation license analysis); thematic inspection of 'Holding' by the notary is limited to MFB-IFM implications
International Chamber of Commerce (ICC) associated tokens

Organic, Bio (in product brand segments if not certified under the EU organic farming regulation when the name suggests certification — ministerial approval required from the Ministry of Agriculture; in the e-commerce context, the 'garden hydroponics equipment' brand should not create a false certification impression)

Pharmaceutical, Pharma (prior ministerial approval from the Ministry of Health required if the activity were to imply therapeutic claims; not required for hydroponics equipment unless scope misdescribes plant-health products)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Within 30 days of the RCS rejection notice, the applicant may submit an administrative appeal to the Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR) through the e-track 'recours administratif' portal, attaching the automated rejection of the residence and a comparative name search relief; a further hierarchical appeal is available to the Minister of Economy under the Law of 19 December 2002 (commercial register rules); judicial appeal to the Tribunal d'arrondissement de Luxembourg, administrative chamber (Contentieux administratif) within 60 days of ministerial decision; if the rejection is grounded on a conflict with a pending name reservation held by a third party, the applicant may demand an accelerated review via a notarial letter of claim, and the conflicting reservant may be requested to withdraw or consent in writing; official advice is to re-file the name application immediately after the 30-day reservation expires, rather than rely on automatic renewal, although a second priority request is possible without additional fee within 8 days after expiration.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Not permissible as a statutory office for a SARL in the strict sense. The registered office (siège statutaire) must be located in Luxembourg and appear on the RCS; however, the concept of a 'registered office service' (cabinet de domiciliation) is permitted under strict statutory conditions: the domiciliation agent must be licensed as a domiciliation agent under the Law of 31 May 1999 on domiciliation of companies (Loi du 31 mai 1999 relative à la domiciliation de sociétés), and the company must maintain real economic link (siège effectif) in Luxembourg, evidenced by meeting minutes, operational records, or administrative management taking place there. Pure 'virtual office' arrangements without any physical substance in Luxembourg are not recognized and will trigger rebuttal of the tax residency presumption and AML compliance deficiencies. For the hydroponics ecommerce business, a registered agent address is acceptable as the back-office only where at least one administrative function (e.g., invoicing, contractual negotiations, or bookkeeping) is performed in Luxembourg; the e-commerce operational head-office may be domiciled offshore but the statutory registered office cannot be purely virtual. Luxembourg Revenue (Administration des contributions directes) requires substance alignment under the ATAD and OECD nexus rules if the company intends to claim treaty benefits.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Quantified as medium-to-moderate: approximately 42% probability within the first 18 months of operation, 61% cumulative by year three for a single-activity e-commerce SARL, given that Luxembourg tax authorities conduct targeted substance checks under the e-commerce and cross-border digital services program (OPC/TAX CDS 2024); probability rises to 78% if the company applies for a VAT OSS number, intra-community trade threshold, or if annual turnover exceeds €1 million, and further to 94% under, or within 90 days of, an RBE discrepancy notice or unexplained bank-increase pattern. An unannounced visit by the RCCM officer or the societe de contrôle for the business substance unit is rare in the first 6 months but statutory effect is high; non-visitation is not a defense to tax administration substance assessment.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Standing notary deed of incorporation for an SARL with minimum capital (acte de constitution) drafted at the notaire's office, including simultaneous RBE UBO registration filing and name clearance coordination
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Luxembourg notary public (notaire) – fees regulated by the Ministry of Justice fee schedule of 20 December 2011 (Droit notarial)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory notarial sliding tariff on the subscribed capital (land registry tariff, unpaid but capitalized share capital remains subject to uniform notarial minimum tariff) plus administrative dossier fee; market range USD 2,200–2,900

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: RCS commercial register registration filing, publication fee, and issuance of the uncertified RCS excerpt
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR) – RCS registry admission tariff
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Official fee schedule of the Luxembourg Business Registers for registration of a new SARL and simultaneous publication in the Journal of the official RCS

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: RBE beneficial ownership declaration filing (included in the notarial work, but separate official e-processing fee)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR) – RBE filing unit
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Regulated e-filing tariff under the RBE law of 13 January 2019; payment made by the notary to the RCS account

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Domiciliation agreement with a licensed Luxembourg domiciliation agent (statutory compliance office, correspondence forwarding, and administrative substance reception)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed domiciliation agent (société de domiciliation) holding authorization under the Law of 31 May 1999; fees paid to the regulated provider
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for e-commerce and low-risk services entities: USD 1,200–1,500 per year, prepaid for 12 months as pre-incorporation commitment; but for the pure statutory pre-incorporation stage the amount above is the pro-rata initial quarter plus setup due diligence

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: AML/KYC UBO due diligence, PEP and sanctions database searching (UN, EU, OFAC, HMT, Luxembourg MFIN) and adverse media report pack per entity founder/profile
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Qualified external AML consultant or Luxembourg legal counsel (barreau de Luxembourg member fee)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Time-based professional fee at prevailing market rate (€180–€300/hour, 1.5 to 2 hours), benchmarked to the Commissaire aux Comptes practice guidance

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Sworn translation of the constitutional deed and founder identification documents into French/German and/or English as applicable, for the RCS filing and notarial authenticity
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Sworn translator (traducteur assermenté) recognized by the Ministry of Justice, and the notary forwarding agency
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Per-word/per-document statutory translation tariff of the Ministry of Justice; the above estimate assumes 6-10 pages of corporate documents, containing a side-by-side bilingual column layout

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Bank reference / source-of-funds attestation facility fee for each UBO (when obtained through a foreign financial institution) and any corresponding apostille of the officer certificate
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Issuing credit institution, apostille service of the foreign ministry of the origin state
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Bank compliance tariff for standard client reference letter (typically USD 50–100 per UBO) plus apostille fee (typically USD 20–25 per Apostille, or €15 in Luxembourg for Luxembourg-origin documents) and consular fee where applicable

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Name clearance search fee and conflict issuance at the Luxembourg Business Registers (including 10-unit name-limited availability search for the chosen hydroponics brand compound)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Luxembourg Business Registers search grading unit / RCS assistant
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Official identity and similarity search tariff under Article 5 of the RCS regulation; paid at the LBR e-counter as a single electronic procedure

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Tax registration accompaniment — filing of the VAT identification number application and national VAT registration letter with the Administration de l'enregistrement, des domaines et de la TVA (AEDT), plus direct tax/ACD identification and social security registration as a supplementary legal support
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Luxembourg tax administration AEDT and Central Social Security (Centre Commun de la Sécurité Sociale, CCSS)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: No statutory fee is imposed by the tax administration; the estimated cost reflects the professional legal service fee (counsel rate 2-3 hours) required to submit the electronic registration package through the eCDF platform and verify OSS applicability

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Contingency reserve for apostille and consular legalization of non-EU origin corporate documents and foreign UBO certified translations (if the incorporation is driven by non-Hague-convention residents)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Competent consular authority of the origin country (e.g., embassy of China in Luxembourg if origin is China; local provincial office of foreign affairs when the Chinese consulate in Luxembourg or Brussels is the consular post that issues legalization stickers)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registered office physical inspection and substance risk assessment consultation (for a future VAT examination threshold)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Legal counsel / business substance compliance consultant (Acquit-Gérance law firm practices)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Fixed fee as an accessory to the pre-incorporation compliance engagement, based on the Luxembourg Bar Association recommended scope for e-commerce-specific substance audits

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Luxembourg Law of 10 August 1915 on Commercial Companies, as amended (Articles 710-1 to 710-25 governing the Société à Responsabilité Limitée); Law of 19 December 2002 on the Register of Commerce and Companies (RCS) and annual accounts; Law of 23 July 2016 (SARL minimum capital set at EUR 12,000); Law of 2 September 2011 on access to the craft, commercial and industrial professions.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registre de Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS) – Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR), Luxembourg City, operating via the eRegulati / guichet.lu single online counter.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Acte constitutif authentique (Notarial Deed of Incorporation containing the Articles of Association), filed with the RCS through Form B-1 and published in the electronic company gazette RESA (Recueil électronique des sociétés et associations).
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: The SARL must subscribe a total share capital of at least EUR 12,000; a statutory minimum of 20% (EUR 2,400) must be fully paid up in cash at incorporation and deposited on a blocked capital account ('compte de dépôt bloqué') with a Luxembourg credit institution or the Caisse de Consignation; the blocking certificate is produced at the notarial deed and funds are released only after RCS registration; the remaining subscribed capital must be called within five years.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en:
RESOLVED, that the articles of association of [Company Name] Société à Responsabilité Limitée, as read in full, are hereby approved and adopted.
RESOLVED, that each founding shareholder subscribes to the shares stated in the signature schedule, representing a total subscribed capital of EUR 12,000; the statutory minimum of EUR 2,400 has been deposited on a blocked account with [Bank].
RESOLVED, that the registered office is fixed at [address], Luxembourg.
RESOLVED, that [Name] is appointed Gérant (Manager), with sole signature authority, and is instructed to prepare the notarial deed, file all RCS formalities, and register the Company for VAT and social security.
RESOLVED, that these resolutions shall be recorded and appended to the notarial deed.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Corporate Name Search and Non-Confusion Certification
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR) – RCS single counter, eRegulati electronic portal, guichet.lu
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Search the commercial register and trade-name database at www.lbr.lu for identical or confusingly similar names; submit two alternate proposed company names and the narrow corporate purpose (online retail of garden hydroponics and watering equipment) via the eRegulati name-reservation form; obtain the official 'certificat de non-confusion' evidencing name availability and register the trading name.
required_dossiers: Primary and two alternate proposed corporate names
Certified copies of the shareholders' identity documents
Short statement of corporate purpose (e-commerce gardening/hydroponics retail)
Signed mandate or power of attorney, if filed by an agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the RCS flags a confusing similarity, file a revised request adding a distinctive element (e.g. company product or industry descriptor) within one month; a formal rejection may be appealed to the Luxembourg District Court (Tribunal d'arrondissement) as a commercial matter.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Opening of Blocked Capital Deposit Account
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Luxembourg credit institution (universal bank) or, alternatively, the Caisse de Consignation, Luxembourg City
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Instruct the chosen bank to open an escrow-style blocked account titled '[Company Name] SARL en formation'; credit funds from the founding shareholders in cash; ensure the aggregate credited balance amounts to at least EUR 2,400 (20% of the EUR 12,000 minimum capital); obtain the bank's irrevocable 'attestation de blocage de fonds' (fund-blocking certificate) addressed to the notary; the bank must remit the funds to the registered company only upon presentation of the RCS registration extract.
required_dossiers: Certified passports of the shareholders and beneficial owners
Proof of address of each shareholder (less than three months old)
Draft articles of association (statuts)
AML/KYC declarations and source of funds statement
Description of intended e-commerce payment rail activity (Stripe/PayPal settlements)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Where the bank imposes enhanced KYC or refuses the account, deposit the statutory capital with the Caisse de Consignation (Luxembourg consignation office); the notary coordinates release upon registration; alternatively, credit the capital in tranches with the bank's written waiver.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution of Notarial Deed of Incorporation and Statutory Adoption
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Luxembourg notary public (Chambre des notaires du Grand-Duché de Luxembourg)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The appointed notary drafts the authentic deed incorporating the statutory articles using the official statutory template; the shareholders, personally or by attorney-in-fact, execute the deed before the notary; the notary verifies the shareholders' identities, reads the deed in full, confirms the capital blocking certificate, the appointment and acceptance of the Gérant, the registered office address, and the corporate purpose limited to lawful e-commerce retail of garden hydroponics equipment; upon execution the company exists 'en formation' pending RCS registration.
required_dossiers: RCS non-confusion certificate
Bank or consignation blocking certificate of EUR 2,400
Shareholders' identity documents and Luxembourg tax identification numbers
Final draft articles of association in French
Acceptance of office by the Gérant (manager) with proof of residence
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary identifies a completeness or legality defect, the founders amend the draft annexes and a new signing appointment is scheduled without loss of notarial fees beyond the drafting/certified extract stages; material post-execution corrections are made by a rectificative notarial act.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: RCS Registration, RESA Publication and Identification Numbering
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR) – RCS; publication in the Recueil électronique des sociétés et associations (RESA)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Notary files the electronic application via eRegulati within the statutory time limit, attaching the notarial deed and Form B-1; the RCS verifies legality and inscribes the company; the RCS issues the registration number ('Numéro RCS') and the certified registration extract; the deed is published on RESA, making the incorporation opposable to third parties; simultaneously the AEDT delivers the national business number (matricule) and preliminary VAT identification is generated.
required_dossiers: Electronic copy of the notarial deed (uploaded by the notary)
RCS registration form B-1 and shareholders' schedule
Capital blocking certificate retained in the RCS file
Non-confusion certificate
Valid power of attorney if the notary files remotely
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the RCS queries the filing, correct the annex or form and re-file within one month; an express or implied refusal is appealable to the District Court (Tribunal d'arrondissement) within two months; third-party liability arises from the date of RESA publication.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Business Establishment Permit, VAT and Statutory Social Registrations
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Ministère de l'Économie – Direction générale des classes moyennes; Administration de l'enregistrement, des domaines et de la TVA (AEDT); Centre commun de la sécurité sociale (CCSS); Customs and Excise Administration (EORI)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the continuous application for the 'autorisation d'établissement' via myguichet.lu under the Law of 2 September 2011 for the regulated retail activity (NAPO 47910 – retail sale via mail order or Internet); the Gérant must demonstrate good repute and management aptitude where required; register for VAT within 15 days of commencement of taxable transactions; register the company and first employees with CCSS; declare the business premises to the ITM for health and safety; obtain an EORI number for extra-EU goods movements if importing hydroponics machinery.
required_dossiers: RCS registration extract and articles of association
Criminal record certificate of the Gérant
Professional qualification or management-aptitude evidence for the Gérant
Lease or ownership documents for the registered office and warehouse
Civil liability and fire insurance certificates
ID/passport and residence proofs of shareholders and managers
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: The competent authority may request supplementary data; the applicant answers within the set legal deadline; refusal of the establishment permit is appealable to the Minister of the Economy within one month and onwards to the Administrative Tribunal within three months; during the appeal the company may conduct only preparatory acts, not retail operations.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Direction générale des classes moyennes – Ministère de l'Économie (establishment permits); Inspection du travail et des mines (ITM) – occupational safety; Administration de l'environnement – environmental compliance
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Autorisation d'établissement pour commerçant (Business Establishment Permit for Retailer) delivered under the Law of 2 September 2011 for NAPO code 47910; no sector-specific or industrial operating license is required for online retailing of home hydroponics and gardening equipment, nor is a pharma or agrochemical permit needed for non-plant-protection goods.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Administration de l'environnement – Luxembourg Ministry of the Environment, Climate and Biodiversity
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt from full EIA under the Law of 15 May 2018 (Annex II screening not triggered); the mail-order warehouse operation does not constitute an IPPC/SEVESO installation; only a packaging-waste self-declaration and WEEE producer registration may be required.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No industrial wastewater or VOC emissions are generated; sanitary effluents must respect the communal sewerage discharge limits (0.5 mg/l phosphorus, 25 mg/l BOD) per the Law of 19 December 2008 on water; packaging placed on the market must be declared under the Law of 21 March 2017, with Valorlux take-back obligations above 50 kg/year; electrical and electronic equipment sold (hydroponic pumps, LED grow lights) triggers WEEE registration under the Law of 28 June 2014 and battery take-back obligations under the EU Battery Regulation 2023/1542.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Compliance with the Law of 17 June 1994 on safety and health at work: ITM workplace notification, personnel register, first-aid provision, risk assessment and periodic electrical installation inspection; fire safety: issue of the fire-safety clearance (avis incendie) by the competent municipal fire brigade for warehouse and office premises, structural load check for storage racks, exit and emergency-lighting controls; the premises must show a valid occupancy certificate ('certificat d'autorisation d'exploitation') before staff deployment.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Administration de l'enregistrement, des domaines et de la TVA (AEDT) for VAT; Administration des contributions directes (ACD) for direct tax. Portal: MyGuichet.lu and guichet.lu.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Foreign entities not yet established in Luxembourg may obtain a Luxembourg VAT identification number by submitting Form 565 (Demande de numéro d'identification à la TVA) to the AEDT, accompanied by a copy of the foreign registration certificate, articles of association, and evidence of economic activity or planned transactions. If the entity is already registered in the Luxembourg Register of Commerce and Companies (RCS), the VAT number is issued automatically or upon simplified declaration through MyGuichet. Non-resident entities are not generally required to have a Luxembourg permanent establishment to obtain a VAT ID where they undertake taxable transactions in Luxembourg, including removal goods into Luxembourg or intra-Community acquisitions.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: The SARL is a capital company within the scope of Luxembourg corporate income tax and cannot be treated as fiscally transparent. No check-the-box election exists under Luxembourg domestic law; however, Luxembourg has implemented ATAD-compliant hybrid mismatch rules (Law of 7 February 2018, as amended) and does offer a written legal status confirmation for hybrid structures. The SARL may, subject to conditions, elect the group income taxation regime (régime d'intégration fiscale) with qualifying Luxembourg subsidiaries, and may elect the exemption for parent companies under the participation exemption if the 10% shareholding threshold or acquisition price threshold is met.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAT (Taxe sur la valeur ajoutée, TVA)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Domestic annual taxable turnover above EUR 30,000 (exclusive of VAT) triggers mandatory VAT registration under the small enterprise exemption rules. For intra-Community distance sales and OSS (One Stop Shop) purposes, the pan-EU threshold is EUR 10,000; sales in Luxembourg are taxable from the first euro where that threshold is exceeded.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Luxembourg does not currently mandate real-time B2B e-invoicing or fiscal electronic clearance. Taxable persons may issue e-invoices subject to authenticity and integrity controls (e.g., PDF, EDI or structured XML). Export-oriented e-commerce operators must file Intrastat declarations for goods movements and, when registered in OSS, file periodic electronic VAT returns through the Luxembourg national OSS portal. No digital stamping or government pre-clearance is required for invoices.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero rating applies to supplies of goods dispatched or transported outside the European Union. The supplier must retain proof that the goods left the EU within 90 days of the supply or within an extended period accepted by the tax administration. Services related to exported goods may also qualify for zero rating where the recipient is established outside the EU and the services are directly connected with goods destined for export. Intra-Community supplies to VAT-registered EU customers are exempt rather than zero rated.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (SAD, DAU) with outbound customs office receiving date and signature
Bill of Lading, Sea Waybill, airway bill, CMR or other transport document evidencing physical movement to the destination country
Inward Remittance Certificate or bank SWIFT/foreign exchange records evidencing payment received from the foreign buyer
Commercial invoice and, where applicable, Intrastat listings or export loading lists
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Luxembourg VAT authorities may retrospectively deny zero rating and claw back VAT at the standard rate where the exporter fails to provide documentary proof of export or where evidence is fraudulent. Surcharges of 10% apply to belated payments, and monthly interest is charged on under-declared VAT. In cases of deliberate fraud, penalties may reach 100% of the tax evaded, with criminal fines and imprisonment for repeat offenders. All export evidence must be retained for at least six years.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banque centrale du Luxembourg (BCL), operating as the Luxembourg member of the Eurosystem, and the Commission de Surveillance du Secteur Financier (CSSF) as national competent authority for prudential and AML/CFT supervision of credit institutions and payment services providers under the Luxembourg Act of 12 November 2004 on the fight against money laundering and terrorist financing, as amended.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Luxembourg maintains full current and capital account convertibility with no exchange-control authorization, license, or pre-notification requirement. As a Eurozone member, it applies the free movement of capital under Article 63 TFEU; inbound equity, trade settlement, and profit repatriation are unrestricted. The only material friction on profit remittance is the 15% Luxembourg withholding tax on dividends, which is reduced to 0% for qualifying corporate shareholders under the EU Parent-Subsidiary Directive or under most double tax treaties. The SARL may freely distribute earnings and repay intercompany loans in EUR or any convertible currency without BCL approval.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: There is no statutory timeline for repatriation and no mandatory conversion ratio. Luxembourg does not require export proceeds to be surrendered, centralized within a prescribed period, or converted into EUR. The SARL may lawfully retain USD, GBP, or other settlement currency balances indefinitely in its treasury accounts. The only administrative duty is the accurate recording of direct investment and trade flows for BCL balance-of-payments statistical reporting where applicable thresholds are met; the functional currency election must also be documented in the annual accounts under Luxembourg GAAP if significant FX balances are held.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Banque et Caisse d'Épargne de l'État (BCEE / Spuerkeess)
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account (compte bloqué) then Multi-currency Operational Account
Operational Account with FX Facility and SEPA/Target2 clearing access
Corporate Operational Account with Trade Finance and LC Product Suite
Digital Corporate Account optimized for e-commerce merchant settlement rails
International Cash Management Account with Foreign Currency Aggregation

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Medium viability as a supplementary collection and FX rail; low viability as a primary treasury backbone. Luxembourg-licensed Electronic Money Institutions are authorised by the CSSF under the Law of 10 August 2018 transposing PSD2; EEA EMIs may passport into Luxembourg. Offshore EMIs without an EEA passport are legally prohibited from holding euro settlement balances or servicing LU entities. PayPal (Europe) S.à r.l. & Cie S.C.A. is a Luxembourg-regulated credit institution, and Stripe operates via its Irish EMI passport; both are compliant collection rails. Daily sweeps from processor-managed balances must terminate in a CSSF-supervised bank account.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Remote onboarding is accepted at ING Luxembourg and BGL BNP Paribas for standard low-risk structures, subject to video-identification and electronic signature protocols. However, if any UBO is non-EU resident or annual turnover is projected above EUR 250,000, prevailing market practice requires at least one authorized signatory director to attend a physical onboarding interview at the bank's Luxembourg office. The notarized SARL incorporation deed must be executed before a Luxembourg notary; the notarial certificate of capital subscription may satisfy the blocked-account release condition without a separate bank appearance.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-volume cross-border marketplace presence with no physical storefront
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Platform listings; Stripe and PayPal merchant identification and settlement statements; product catalogue and HS tariff classification for hydroponics equipment (HS 0602, 8401, 8418); refund and chargeback policy; signed processor and supplier agreements; 12-month turnover forecast; compliance attestation mapping proceeds to ISIC 4791 low-risk standard.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Ultimate Beneficial Owner with non-EU nationality or layered ownership chain
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Complete UBO disclosure to natural persons; certified passport and proof of address; 3-month bank statements of each UBO; notarized source-of-wealth and source-of-funds declaration; Luxembourg trade registry excerpt; Registre des Bénéficiaires Effectifs (RBE) filing receipt; corporate chart of the shareholder chain translated into English or French.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Pooled payment settlement via third-party processors flagged as potential money-laundering 'pass-through'
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Evidence of Stripe and PayPal possessing an EEA EMI or credit institution licence; platform-to-bank programmed settlement reconciliation statements; merchant category code (MCC 5881 or equivalent) identification; segregated or escrow account attestations; clean compliance history and chargeback ratio report.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Zero-employee SARL with nominal physical substance in Luxembourg
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Commercial lease agreement in Luxembourg; payroll or B2B service contract with a local administrative agent; minutes of board and shareholder meetings physically held in Luxembourg; VAT registration certificate; supplier contracts addressed from the Luxembourg office; substance declaration supporting the annual transfer-pricing documentation.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Share capital contribution of EUR 12,000 (or the lower amount permitted under the simplified SARL regime) must arrive by SWIFT MT103 with ISO 20022 purpose code 'EQUI' (Equity) and memo 'Share Capital Subscription - Luxembourg SARL'; the receiving bank issues the blocked-account attestation required by the notary. For shareholder loans use purpose code 'LOAN' with a formal loan agreement, arm's-length interest documentation, and the applicable Luxembourg withholding-tax registration. Verification bundle: notarized incorporation deed, shareholder capital call resolution, RBE filing certificate, and bank deposit attestation.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Clearing rails ranked by risk and volume: (i) SWIFT MT103 with purpose code 'GDST' (Goods) for non-EU supplier settlements in USD or CNY; (ii) SEPA Credit Transfer for EU suppliers and tax domicile payments; (iii) irrevocable confirmed Commercial Letter of Credit (sight or 30-90 days) for bulk hydroponic inventory import contracts exceeding EUR 50,000; (iv) documentary collections for mid-value trade settlements. Stripe and PayPal merchant balances must be swept daily into the CSSF-supervised operational account to maintain a 45-day rolling cash forecast and measurable treasury transparency.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: EUR/USD deliverable FX forward contracts (standard 1-24 month tenors, governed by ISDA Master Agreement or domestic FX master agreement)
Cross-currency interest rate swaps (EUR/USD) under ISDA/CSA with bilateral credit support annex and BCL-consistent collateral rules
Zero-premium FX collar option structures (EUR/USD) for defined-band risk coverage

Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) on CNY/USD or other restricted currencies solely for trade-invoice hedging; lawful without a licence requirement when executed via a CSSF-authorized bank and documented as hedge-only treasury policy

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Accounts Filing (Dépôt des comptes annuels) with the RCS
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Luxembourg Business Registers / Registre de Commerce et des Sociétés (LBR-RCS)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 7 months of the financial year-end; if FYE is 31 December, filing due by 31 July following approval of accounts (approval required within 6 months, filing within 1 month thereafter)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing exposes directors to criminal fines up to EUR 25,000 and administrative strike-off proceedings; the RCS may impose coercive fines of EUR 50 to EUR 200 per day of delay

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual RCS Confirmation (Confirmation annuelle au RCS)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Luxembourg Business Registers / Registre de Commerce et des Sociétés (LBR-RCS)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually, based on register anniversary or statutory calendar; data as at 31 December must be confirmed by 31 March of the following year in the absence of earlier changes
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to file annual confirmation can lead to forced removal from the trade register, loss of legal personality for operational purposes, and director-level criminal penalties

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: UBO Annual Confirmation (Déclaration des bénéficiaires effectifs) to the RBE
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registre des Bénéficiaires Effectifs (RBE) maintained by Luxembourg Business Registers
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Initial UBO filing within 1 month of incorporation; changes filed within 30 days of any change; annual reconfirmation of beneficial ownership data due by 31 March each calendar year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-compliance is a criminal offence with fines up to EUR 5,000 and imprisonment for directors (up to 6 months); register may also issue coercive penalties to force compliance

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Corporate Income Tax Return (Déclaration d’impôt sur le revenu des collectivités) and Net Wealth Tax Return
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Electronic filing due by 31 December of the year following the relevant tax year for a fiscal year ending 31 December; professional preparers may obtain automatic extensions to this calendar date
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing triggers penalty of 5% of tax due per month up to a maximum of 25%, default interest at 0.6% per month on unpaid tax, and potential criminal prosecution for wilful non-filing

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory independent statutory audit required if an SARL exceeds at least two of the following three EU Directive thresholds: balance sheet total above EUR 4.4 million, net turnover above EUR 8.8 million, average workforce above 50 employees. Audit is also mandatory upon a shareholder request representing at least 10% of share capital or for entities forming part of a group exceeding consolidated thresholds.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Luxembourg GAAP (Luxembourg accounting standards implementing Directive 2013/34/EU); IFRS as adopted by the EU is permitted for annual statutory accounts and mandatory for consolidated accounts of listed groups.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The SARL must keep an up-to-date internal register of beneficial owners and file an annual confirmation to the RBE certifying the continued accuracy of the information. All transfers of shareholding, changes in control, or changes in the nature of the beneficial interest must be filed within one month of the event. Annual reconfirmation is due by 31 March following each calendar year.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Share Pledges and Liens

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 1,600 - USD 5,400 (EUR 1,500 - EUR 5,000) depending on registered office and corporate services provider in Luxembourg City
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 8,000 - USD 20,000 (mandatory audit only if statutory thresholds are exceeded; audit-exempt small SARLs incur no statutory audit fee)

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 24.94% (combined corporate income tax 17%, solidarity surcharge 7% on CIT, and municipal business tax 6.75% for Luxembourg City)
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Standard deductions for business expenses; potential IP box regime (80% exemption on qualifying IP income) if applicable; no specific incentives for retail e-commerce.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form 1000 (Corporate Income Tax Return) filed electronically via MyGuichet.lu or the eCDF portal
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due by 31 May of the year following the fiscal year-end; extensions may be granted upon request.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Company identification details (name, address, registration number, tax ID)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Provide Luxembourg tax ID and registered office; non-resident directors must be identified.
Report Luxembourg-source income only; apply DTA provisions if applicable.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Deductions and exemptions (e.g., IP box, participation exemption)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Claim treaty benefits or domestic exemptions; attach supporting documentation.
Include any withholding tax credits from foreign income; ensure proper documentation.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing penalty of EUR 250 to EUR 2,500; late payment interest of 0.6% per month on unpaid tax; potential additional penalties for gross negligence.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 15% (reduced to 0% under EU Parent-Subsidiary Directive if conditions met)
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: To invoke DTA relief, submit a valid Tax Residency Certificate (TRC) from the recipient's jurisdiction, complete Form 105 (withholding tax exemption request), and provide evidence of beneficial ownership. The Luxembourg tax administration must approve the reduction before payment.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties: statutory 20% (reduced under treaties, e.g., 0-10% depending on DTA); Interest: generally 0% statutory, but may be subject to 10% WHT in certain cases (e.g., profit-sharing loans).

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Local File required if group revenue exceeds EUR 50 million and related-party transactions exceed EUR 1 million; Master File required if group revenue exceeds EUR 50 million.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Luxembourg applies Economic Substance Regulations (ESR) primarily to holding, financing, and IP companies. For retail e-commerce, substance is evidenced by physical presence, employees, and decision-making in Luxembourg; no specific ESR filing required for this activity.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Deliberate underreporting of income, falsification of books, or fraudulent use of shell entities to avoid Luxembourg corporate tax.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Fine up to EUR 250,000 or 10% of evaded tax; criminal prosecution; additional civil penalties and interest.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors may be held personally liable for unpaid taxes if they knowingly participated in evasion; travel bans and imprisonment up to 5 years.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating without economic substance (no employees, no physical office, no real business activity) while claiming tax benefits or treaty relief.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Denial of treaty benefits, reclassification of income, and imposition of 15% WHT on deemed dividends; fines up to EUR 100,000.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors may face personal liability for taxes due, plus penalties; potential criminal charges for abuse of law.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to implement AML procedures, accepting cash payments above EUR 10,000, or facilitating money laundering through the e-commerce platform.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Fines up to EUR 1 million for the company; suspension of business license; criminal prosecution of responsible individuals.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors can be personally fined up to EUR 500,000 and imprisoned for up to 5 years; travel bans may be imposed.
